text: Write the words of the dialogue which takes place between Mother and Son after her
In the dialogue you should include:
• Mother’s complaints about the journey, and her reasons for not wanting to make it
• Son’s dissatisfaction with his life, and his plans for the future
• Mother’s response to Son’s feelings and intentions.
Base your dialogue on what you have read in Passage A. Address all three bullet points. Be
careful to use your own words.
Write between 1½ and 2 sides, allowing for the size of your handwriting.
Up to 15 marks are available for the content of your answer, and up to 5 marks for the
